description: Mark a repository already connected to a project as the project's open source repository, or take the mark off. Marking asks its host, without a token, whether anybody can read it and under which licence, and is refused for a private one. Taking the mark off the last marked repository of a public project closes the project to readers outside at once, as the screen does — confirm with the person first. Only the project's lead, a board administrator or a company admin may; both are written to the company's journal.

openSource.description: true to mark it open source, false to take the mark off.

repository.description: The repository: its id from list_repositories, or its path, e.g. 'owner/repo'.

name: set_repository_open_source
